mapper.select: SELECT started_at FROM broadcast_sessions WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND status IN ('PREPARING', 'LIVE')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO triggers (session_id, trigger_type, start_ms, end_ms, started_at, ended_at, peak_z, peak_engagement, avg_viewers, chat_count, unique_chatters, analyzed_chat, joy_count, excitement_count, support_count, surprise_count, sadness_count, anger_count, confusion_count, neutral_count) SELECT #{sessionId}, 'CHAT_SURGE', #{startMs}, #{endMs}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt}, #{peakZ}, #{peakEngagement}, COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(AVG(viewer_count))::INT FROM viewer_metrics WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND measured_at BETWEEN #{startedAt} AND #{endedAt}), 0), COUNT(*)::INT, COUNT(DISTINCT viewer_id)::INT, COUNT(sentiment_label)::INT, (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'JOY'))::INT, (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'EXCITEMENT'))::INT, (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'SUPPORT'))::INT, (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'SURPRISE'))::INT, (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'SADNESS'))::INT, (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'ANGER'))::INT, (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'CONFUSION'))::INT, (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'NEUTRAL'))::INT FROM chat_messages WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND sent_at BETWEEN #{startedAt} AND #{endedAt} ON CONFLICT (session_id, start_ms) DO NOTHING
